subject: FY25 Budget Update
overview: The Medford School Committee held a special remote meeting to appoint non-voting members to the high school building committee and review revenue strategies for the fiscal year 2025 budget.

items.title: High School Building Committee Non-Voting Members
items.summary: The committee voted to approve Larry Brown and Philip Santos as non-voting members of the Medford Comprehensive High School Building Committee.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2025 Budget Update
items.summary: CFO Gerry McCue presented potential revenue sources and cost-saving measures for the FY25 budget, including program chargebacks, utilization of revolving and capital funds, and expected increases in Chapter 70 state funding.
